did.description: DID of the aggregator (did:plc or did:web format)

domain.description: Hostname where the aggregator is hosted, without scheme (e.g., 'rss-bot.example.com'). Must serve a .well-known/atproto-did file containing the DID.

errors.name: InvalidDID
errors.description: DID format is invalid or not did:plc or did:web format

errors.name: DomainVerificationFailed
errors.description: Could not verify domain ownership via .well-known/atproto-did or DID mismatch

errors.name: AlreadyRegistered
errors.description: This aggregator DID is already registered with this instance

errors.name: DIDResolutionFailed
errors.description: Could not resolve DID document to extract handle and PDS URL

errors.name: RegistrationFailed
errors.description: Internal server error occurred during registration

main.description: Register an existing aggregator DID with this Coves instance. Aggregators must first create their own DID via PLC directory, then call this endpoint to register. Domain ownership is verified via .well-known/atproto-did file.
